run_challenge_eval: run the AdsorbML challenge evaluation script with a prediction NPZ file and model name to compute success rate
run_is_successful: run the is_successful function to check if a predicted energy is within threshold of the DFT energy
run_compute_valid_ml_success: run compute_valid_ml_success to calculate validated ML success rates comparing ML predictions against DFT ground truth
run_get_dft_data: run get_dft_data to organize target mapping into a lookup dictionary of system IDs to DFT adsorption energies
run_process_ml_data: run process_ml_data to parse an NPZ prediction file and build ML energy data with DFT validation values
